qa_pairs.question: What is the function of the CPU graph on the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: The CPU graph allows users to visualize the CPU cores they have requested over time.

qa_pairs.question: How can users customize the view in the CPU graph?
qa_pairs.answer: Users can select or deselect different CPU cores within the graph according to their needs.

qa_pairs.question: Is the CPU graph always available for all tasks?
qa_pairs.answer: No, the CPU graph is not available for very short tasks.
